skill.name: product-launch-video
skill.description: Create branded product launch videos from a marketing URL, script, or brief. The workflow plans, builds, captions, validates, and renders HyperFrames promotional videos.
skill.summary: Turn approved product messaging into a branded launch video and final MP4.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: All 400 presented static findings were adjudicated. Most are false positives caused by template literals, RegExp.exec, fixed relative references, and expected local media processing; confirmed findings cover environment-selected Node execution, automatic credential-backed requests, and CDN runtime loading. Two semantic findings identify silent package updates and automatic use of existing provider credentials. Static review was capped at 400/560 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 160 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The skill updates itself with npx without approval.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the silent update instruction. Pin reviewed versions and require explicit user confirmation before downloading or executing updates.

remediation.issue: HF_MEDIA_ENGINE controls the JavaScript file passed to Node.
remediation.suggestion: Remove this override, or resolve a fixed allowlisted engine path inside the installed media-use package before spawning Node.

remediation.issue: Existing provider keys and shared HeyGen credentials can be used automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Request consent before each provider-backed operation and disclose the provider, data sent, charges, and offline alternative.

remediation.issue: Rendered output loads GSAP from a third-party CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a reviewed local copy or retain integrity pinning with an offline fallback and clear network disclosure.

finding_verdicts.reason: The match is a JavaScript Map.keys() call while reporting missing frame durations, not certificate or private-key file access.
The audio adapter selects a Node.js program from HF_MEDIA_ENGINE and executes it. An attacker controlling that environment variable can cause arbitrary local JavaScript execution.
The documentation asks to display authentication status and explicitly tells users not to write keys into a repository .env file. It does not read or transmit environment files.
The workflow automatically detects named provider keys and uses them for capture without a dedicated consent gate. This can cause unanticipated credential-backed requests and data sharing.
The referenced hidden paths are project metadata such as .hyperframes or the documented shared HeyGen credential location. There is no evidence of hidden-file harvesting.
The child-process module is used for fixed ffprobe and ffmpeg invocations to inspect and extend local BGM files. The executable names and arguments are constructed for the local project workflow.
The imported child-process API is used to run Node with the engine selected by HF_MEDIA_ENGINE. This creates an arbitrary-program execution path when that environment is untrusted.

content.user_title: Create Product Launch Videos from Briefs or URLs
content.value_statement: Product teams often need a polished launch video without a full production workflow. This skill turns source material into branded, reviewed, and rendered HyperFrames video assets.
actual_capabilities: Builds a video brief from a marketing URL, pasted script, or product description.
Captures product content and organizes brand tokens, visible text, and media assets.
Creates a storyboard, narration script, scene timing, motion direction, and asset assignments.
Coordinates narration, music retrieval, sound effects, captions, and duration synchronization.
Builds HTML frame compositions, validates the result, creates previews, and renders an approved MP4.
limitations: Requires HyperFrames, Node.js, and several sibling HyperFrames skills and reference packages.
Website capture and HeyGen media features require network access and may require provider credentials.
Full background music looping depends on ffmpeg and ffprobe being available.
Generated claims, brand details, asset rights, and final visual quality still require human review.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a product page and release brief into a concise feature reveal for social channels or an embedded player.

use_cases.title: Present a New Startup
use_cases.description: Convert a company website and positioning notes into a branded launch story with narration, captions, and product visuals.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Variants
use_cases.description: Create landscape, square, or portrait launch videos with consistent story structure and channel-specific pacing.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Product Promo
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second launch video from [product URL]. Highlight [main benefit] for [audience] and prepare a landscape version.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a clear product page and message.

prompt_templates.title: Script-Led Feature Reveal
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this script for a product reveal: [script]. Preserve the core claims, improve pacing, and propose the storyboard before production.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team already has approved messaging but needs visual planning.

prompt_templates.title: Channel-Specific Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration] launch video for [channel] in [aspect ratio]. Use [voice style], [brand constraints], and these approved assets: [assets].
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketer needs a deliverable tailored to a distribution channel.

prompt_templates.title: Controlled Multi-Stage Production
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a launch video for [product] in collaborative mode. Validate every claim, use only licensed assets, document scene rationale, and pause before rendering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced production with compliance, review, and asset controls.

output_examples.input: Create a 45-second landscape promo from our product page for operations leaders.
output: A locked brief covering audience, message, length, destination, and language.
A frame-by-frame storyboard with narration, timing, asset choices, and motion direction.
An approved landscape MP4 with captions, audio, and a contact sheet.

output_examples.input: Turn this approved script into a square feature reveal with a calm female voice.
output_examples.output: A square product reveal that preserves approved claims, applies the selected brand preset, synchronizes narration, and pauses for review before rendering.

output_examples.input: Create a silent portrait teaser using only our supplied screenshots and logo.
output_examples.output: A portrait teaser using the provided assets, timed motion, optional sound effects, validation results, and a rendered MP4 after approval.

best_practices: Provide one clear audience, one main message, and the intended distribution channel.
Use approved claims and licensed assets, then review the storyboard before frame production.
Confirm credential use, provider selection, voice choice, and final render approval.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a general website tour when the goal is not product promotion.
Do not provide unverified performance claims, private customer data, or unlicensed media.
Do not bypass storyboard approval, validation checks, or the final review pause.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: You can provide a product URL, marketing URL, pasted script, product brief, or a combination of these sources.

faq.question: Which video formats are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow supports landscape, square, and portrait formats based on the selected distribution destination.

faq.question: Can it create narration and captions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can coordinate supported text-to-speech providers, word timing, captions, music retrieval, and sound effects.

faq.question: Does it require a HeyGen account?
faq.answer: No. Local audio engines can support offline work, but HeyGen services require sign-in and may provide additional media options.

faq.question: Can I use only my approved assets?
faq.answer: Yes. State that requirement and provide the assets. Review the storyboard inventory before production begins.

faq.question: What should I review before rendering?
faq.answer: Check claims, script wording, brand tokens, asset rights, voice selection, storyboard timing, captions, and the preview contact sheet.
